text: When Tough and Balanced both apply to a unit, they apply one after the other, from top to bottom. If Tough is augmented onto a Balanced unit, or a Tough unit attacks with a Balanced unit behind it, the unit has its defense doubled, then its stats balanced. If Tough is applied to a Balanced unit, it has its stats balanced, then its defense doubled. Attributes granted by a unit's augments apply in the order the mods were gained, the first attached first, and attributes shared from its column apply from front to back. An attribute the unit has from more than one source takes the position of the first.
